description: Site header with logo, primary navigation menu, and hamburger toggle on mobile. Reads a registered WP nav menu by theme location.

location.description: WP theme location slug for the nav menu.

logo_text.description: Logo text wordmark. Falls back to pp_site_title() when empty. Shown when no logo image resolves.

logo_id.description: Media Library attachment ID for the logo image (NOT a URL). When it resolves to an image, renders an img tag instead of the text wordmark. Resolution order: this prop, then the pp_logo_id site option, then the WP custom_logo theme-mod.

logo_alt.description: Alt text for the logo image. Defaults to the attachment's own alt metadata, then logo_text/site title.
